messages:
evan_product: Publishing preview docs for the Attested Audit Protocol (AAP) and the Telemetry Redaction Guide for Private & Dedicated customers. This is a follow-up to the telemetry opt-in work; AAP gives customers a signed, verifiable audit bundle they can hand to auditors without sharing raw payloads. Docs: https://redwood.internal/docs/aap-preview :mag_right:

evan_product: TL;DR: AAP = signed manifest + manifests of redaction rules + optional redaction proof. Customers can choose one of three modes: full-bundle (forensic), redacted-bundle (PII removed), or metadata-only (operational only).

marcos_security: Important note on threat model: redaction is deterministic and performed at agent-side for on-prem and VPC agents v3.2+. We include a cryptographic proof (signature + nonce) that the bundle was produced by a specific agent build and key. We DO NOT ever send raw customer inputs to Redwood telemetry unless the customer explicitly opts in.

priya_legal: Added checklist for auditors in the doc: what signatures validate which fields, how to verify chain-of-trust, and a sample SOC/ISO statement. Legal recommends customers request the "redacted-bundle" by default unless their contract requires full bundles. Also adding standard SCADA/regulated-sector language where needed.

oliver_engineering: Note on rollout: feature flags in Console are behind a beta gate. For private tenants we will list AAP under Security -> Audit exports. API: POST /v1/private/{tenant}/audit-export with body {"mode": "redacted|full|meta", "kms_key": "<key>"}. Example curl:
```
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.example/v1/private/acme-corp/audit-export" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"mode":"redacted","kms_key":"projects/acme-kms/keys/audit-key"}'
```

oliver_engineering: On-prem agent: run `agent-cli export-audit --mode redacted --out audit.tar.gz` (requires agent v3.2+ and an agent KMS alias).

emily_support: I'll draft support articles for the three most common failure modes: missing signature (caused by agent version drift), KMS permission denied, and export size/timeouts. Assigning myself to own the first-run debug doc.

marcos_security: Telemetry redaction rules are configurable JSON with allowlist/denylist patterns and regex masks. We ship default templates for common PII (SSNs, emails, credit cards) and for LLM-specific artifacts (prompt embeddings). Customers can supply additional custom masks.

priya_legal: Quick policy point: for customers in EU data-residency regions, the default for new Private accounts will be "metadata-only" until they explicitly opt to share redacted or full bundles with auditors. This aligns with our cross-border data policy.

evan_product: Roadmap & timeline: preview docs live now; limited beta (10 customers) opens next week; GA targeted in 8-10 weeks pending pilot feedback. No immediate price change; premium audit support add-on TBD.

deploy-bot: FYI: feature flags for AAP were enabled in staging-us-east and staging-eu on 2026-04-01T05:10Z. Canary schedule: 2026-04-02 01:00Z.

emily_support: Can we get a one-pager for CSEs that summarizes request patterns and consent language? I'll coordinate with product for that.

oliver_engineering: Yes. Also: please collect pilot customers who need HSM-backed attestation keys. We currently support customer-managed KMS; HSM-as-a-service is on roadmap but not ready for beta.

priya_legal: Flagging two legal items: (1) update DPA to mention AAP export handling, (2) create a sample auditor NDA addendum for handling non-redacted bundles.

marcos_security: SRE note: export size can grow with large audit windows; we'll implement streaming export (gzip + chunked) for on-prem later in the quarter. For now, recommend 7-day windows for full-bundle exports.

evan_product: Thanks team. Action items: emily -> support docs, priya -> DPA and addendum drafts, oliver -> CLI/REST examples in docs, marcos -> redaction templates and agent compat matrix. We'll reconvene after initial pilot signups.

oliver_engineering: Posting pilot signup form here for teams: https://redwood.internal/pilot/aap-signup. Please nominate customers by EOD Friday.

evan_product: End of thread update: preview announcement sent to AE/Sales and channel partners at 2026-04-01T16:40Z. Will post pilot roster and first pilot notes in this thread when available. :white_check_mark:
